status.detail: The earlier managed test-project restore created its four expected assets files, but required native package imports remain absent. Three subsequent repository-wrapper invocations returned zero without restoring packages because the restore argument was incorrectly bound as a path. The missing imports were detected, so neither production nor test builds nor any tests were run. This is an orchestration failure, not a successful restore or product failure. A named-parameter correction is being statically checked before another assigned slot. Exact-head validation remains incomplete; no review conclusion is claimed.
